changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: GIN index on n_lead.contacts for lead search by phone (contact containment)
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_n_lead_contacts_gin ON n_lead USING GIN (contacts);
COMMENT ON INDEX idx_n_lead_contacts_gin IS 'GIN index on n_lead.contacts for lead search by phone number (contacts @> array of contact id)';
